class InterfaceSuite:
    def time_mcp_inspect(
        self, _declarations: dict[int, list[InstalledPlugin]], _nodes: int
    ) -> None:
        """Inspect the executable metric contract."""
        self.loop.run(
            execute_tool(
                "lyra_get_metric",
                self.inspection,
                self.backend,
                public_api_base_url="https://benchmark.invalid",
            )
        ).model_dump_json()

    def setup(self, declarations: dict[int, list[InstalledPlugin]], nodes: int) -> None:
        """Prepare transport, event loop, catalog, and a bounded job-store fake."""
        self.catalog = catalog(declarations[nodes])
        self.discovery = self.catalog.discovery
        self.jobs = Mock()
        self.jobs.enqueue.side_effect = lambda *_: self.jobs.reset_mock()
        self.runtime = Mock(
            spec=ApplicationRuntime, catalog=self.catalog, jobs=self.jobs
        )
        self.backend = InProcessLyraBackend(lambda: self.runtime)
        self.results = results.ResultSuite()
        self.results.setup(1000)
    
        async def observe(_job_id: str) -> JobObservation:
            await asyncio.sleep(0)
            return self.results.observation
    
        self.jobs.observe_job = observe
        self.result_request = GetJobResultInput(result_ref="lyra://results/benchmark")
        self.loop = asyncio.Runner()
        app = FastAPI()
        app.state.runtime = Mock(
            spec=ApplicationRuntime, credentials=Mock(agent_api_key="fixture-key")
        )
        app.include_router(metrics.router)
        app.include_router(jobs.router)
        app.dependency_overrides[get_catalog] = lambda: self.catalog
        app.dependency_overrides[get_jobs] = lambda: self.jobs
        self.client = httpx.AsyncClient(
            transport=httpx.ASGITransport(app=app),
            base_url="http://benchmark.invalid",
            headers={"Authorization": "Bearer fixture-key"},
        )
        self.request = JobCreateRequest(metric="source", input={})
        self.search = SearchMetricsInput(query="population")
        self.listing = ListMetricsInput()
        self.inspection = GetMetricInput(metric="source")

    def setup_cache(self) -> dict[int, list[InstalledPlugin]]:
        """Return installed declaration fixtures for each catalog size."""
        return {
            nodes: installed(workload(1, "catalog", nodes).plugin)
            for nodes in self.params
        }

class ProvenanceSuite:
    def time_construct(self) -> None:
        """Construct an immutable current-run record from retained components."""
        ExecutionProvenance(
            self.record.accepted,
            self.record.native_inputs,
            self.record.observations,
            succeeded=True,
        )

    def setup(self) -> None:
        """Capture representative accepted metadata and native summaries."""
        suite = CanonicalExecutionSuite()
        suite.setup("routed", 1000, 2)
        suite.executor.execute(suite.prepared)
        self.record = cast("ExecutionProvenance", suite.executor.provenance)

class BoundWorkerSuite:
    def time_execute(self) -> None:
        """Deserialize and execute captured bindings without queue connections."""
        with (
            patch.dict(worker.RUNNER_REGISTRY, {"two": self.entry}),
            patch.object(
                worker,
                "require_worker_config",
                return_value=self.config,
            ),
            patch.object(worker, "build_run_context", return_value=Mock()),
        ):
            worker.execute_bound_job(self.payload, cast("Job", self.native))

    def setup(self) -> None:
        """Prepare a two-input route and an in-process storage fake."""
        self.suite = CanonicalExecutionSuite()
        self.suite.setup("routed", 2, 2)
        self.payload = serialize_bound_plan(self.suite.prepared)
        self.native = SimpleNamespace(
            id="benchmark", origin="heavy", meta={}, save_meta=Mock()
        )
        self.scratch = TemporaryDirectory()
        self.config = load_test_config(Path(self.scratch.name))
        plugin = self.suite.executor.plugins["bench"]
        self.entry = worker.RunnerMetricEntry(
            "two",
            "heavy",
            self.suite.catalog.graph.nodes["two"].node,
            self.suite.catalog.manifests["bench"],
            "bench",
            plugin,
            self.suite.catalog.graph,
            {"bench": plugin},
            self.suite.executor.location_provider,
        )

class ResultSuite:
    def time_preview(self, _rows: int) -> None:
        """Build bounded MCP previews and output summaries."""
        project_observation(
            "benchmark", self.observation, "https://benchmark.invalid"
        ).model_dump_json()

    def setup(self, rows: int) -> None:
        """Prepare a real worker entry with a native job double."""
        self.work = workload(rows)
        plugin = installed(self.work.plugin)[0]
        contract = next(node for node in plugin.manifest.nodes if node.name == "root")
        self.provenance = JobRunProvenance(
            metric="root",
            catalog_fingerprint="fixture",
            plugin=plugin.manifest.plugin,
            input={},
            outputs=contract.outputs,
            created_at=datetime(2026, 1, 1, tzinfo=UTC),
        )
        self.entry = worker.RunnerMetricEntry(
            metric_name="root",
            queue="default",
            contract=contract,
            plugin=plugin.manifest,
            distribution=plugin.distribution,
            definition=self.work.plugin,
            graph=build_graph({plugin.distribution: plugin.manifest.nodes}),
            implementations={plugin.distribution: self.work.plugin},
        )
        self.native = Mock(
            id="benchmark",
            origin="default",
            meta={
                "contract": contract.model_dump(mode="json"),
                "distribution": plugin.distribution,
                "provenance": self.provenance.model_dump(mode="json"),
            },
        )
        self.envelope = validate_json_object(
            {"job_id": "benchmark", "metric": "root", "input": {}}
        )
        self.result = TableJobResult.model_validate(
            {
                "job_id": "benchmark",
                "outputs": serialize_outputs("root", {"root": frame(rows)}),
                "output_metadata": contract.outputs,
                "provenance": self.provenance,
            }
        )
        self.observation = JobObservation(
            snapshot=JobStatusInfo(
                job_id="benchmark",
                metric="root",
                status="succeeded",
                created_at=self.provenance.created_at,
                updated_at=self.provenance.created_at,
                completed_at=self.provenance.created_at,
            ),
            result=self.result,
            provenance=self.provenance,
        )
        self.registry_patch = patch.dict(
            worker.RUNNER_REGISTRY, {"root": self.entry}, clear=True
        )
        self.config_patch = patch.object(
            worker,
            "require_worker_config",
            return_value=Mock(
                spec=LyraConfig, jobs=Mock(), cache_dir=None, resources={}
            ),
        )
        self.registry_patch.start()
        self.config_patch.start()

class StorageSuite:
    def time_construct(self, _case: str) -> None:
        """Construct an owned typed snapshot."""
        Snapshot.from_frame(self.frame, self.schema)

    def setup(self, case: str) -> None:
        """Prepare validated data and warm artifact identities."""
        kind, size = case.split("-")
        rows = 1000 if size == "small" else 10000
        self.frame = frame(rows, kind)
        self.schema = schema(self.frame)
        self.snapshot = Snapshot.from_frame(self.frame, self.schema)
        self.encoded = ipc_codec.encode(self.snapshot)
